notes:
0.9.73-beta 179 Paris
• Shared matters keep to their own folder: nothing from a server or another member is written or read outside the matter.
• Matter archives from others are checked before they are unpacked, and the copy is always your own.
• Share Matter leaves the matter's backups and this Mac's records out of the archive and sends a compacted database.
• Citations write page and paragraph signs in the matter's language: "Beilage 3, S. 4"; Rn. in a matter from Germany.
• A password-protected matter asks for its password however it is opened, not only at start.
• A deleted matter goes to the Trash, where the Finder can put it back.
• People & Connections keeps the person you picked when a shared matter refreshes.
